_doc: The game's current screens. res = window size for that screen (default 1280x720; small sizes check the game still lays out). `gamekit ui-shots bach-ai` captures each one into production/ui/<name>.png (overwriting) and the studio dashboard shows exactly this set. Re-run after any change the player can see, then commit production/ui. scene empty = main scene (the title screen); frames = 60 per second of game time (times --sim-steps).
